title: I loved Forbidden Memories fusion system, so I’m making my own card game around it, Looking for feedback.
author: The_Faceless1
selftext:
Hi! I grew up playing Yu Gi Oh Forbidden Memories and always wished someone would build a modern game around its fusion idea. So I started making one: **AspectForge**.

• Fuse two creatures on the board into stronger Rank 2 / Rank 3 monsters  
• Magic, hidden traps and Realms that change the field  
• Aspects give type advantage, a bit like FM’s guardian stars

Art is AI-assisted; the game design and code are my own. No demo yet, I want to hear what you think first:

1. Does the fusion look satisfying?
2. Im planning too make this game easy to understand, Yu Gi Oh has becoming way too complex.
3. Do you think its too slop? which part is a bit too slop other than the board?

Everything still WIP, but the core gameplay already fixed. 

Looking forward for your feedback. If its positive I will probably release it middle of next year, already have a plan for the campaign and the multiplayer.
